_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Critical Item Characteristics List
summary: The Critical Item Characteristics List identifies and documents components, assemblies, and processes with critical characteristics that could cause an unsafe condition if nonconforming.
use_relationship:
The Critical Item Characteristics List (CICL) is used to identify and document components, assemblies, and processes with one or more critical characteristics that if not conforming to the design data or quality requirements would result in an unsafe condition.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of any documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the current issue of the DODISS at the time of the solicitation, or for non DODISS-listed documents, as stated herein.

preparation_instructions.title: When referenced within the Technical Data Package, a critical characteristic is defined by DOD-STD-2101.
Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The CICL shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The list shall identify the following elements:

children.title: Contract Number and the date of the report.
Critical item identification including the part number, nomenclature, and National Stock Number.
Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) Code that identifies the manufacturer of the critical item.
Analytical data and results, which support the determination that an item and associated characteristics are critical.
Documents which control the critical characteristics.
Service life, if established, for the critical item.
The most effective inspection method to be performed on the critical item to inspect the critical characteristics.
children.content: The inspection method shall include any applicable test requirements (e.g., test equipment, test conditions, detailed test procedures, test results).

preparation_instructions.title: Media requirements.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in Adobe electronic Portable Document Format (pdf), version 2007-2010.
